description: Submits the driver's details for the booking in progress and returns the booking summary with its confirmation_token. terms_accepted records that the customer accepted the company's terms and must be true.

language.description: Language of the conversation, BCP-47 (es, en, pt-BR, fr, de, it…). Defaults to 'en'. Bota also answers in the language the customer writes.

phone.description: With country code (+1…). Required by most companies.

session_id.description: Booking session id returned by a previous call for this company (offers, selection, customer details). Omitted, a new session starts.

name: provide_customer_details
title: Provide driver details
